narrative: On the bookwheel. Holinshed, still Field's and still not returned, is pushed to the back. Brooke is brought to the front and left shut. A clean sheet lies beside it. Nothing is written on the sheet.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Brought Brooke forward, shut, and left the sheet blank.

entities.name: Brooke's Romeus and Juliet
entities.context: Shown on book in Brooke brought forward

entities.name: Holinshed
